Title: G-Series instances for Azure Virtual Machines available in Australia East

Body.Content: Azure Virtual Machines customers can take advantage of the G-Series instances now available in Australia East. They feature the latest Intel Xeon processor E5 v3 family and provide exceptional computational performance, more memory, and more local solid-state drive (SSD) storage than any current virtual machine size in Azure. This makes them ideal for your most demanding applications. For more information, please visit the Virtual Machines page and the Virtual Machines pricing page.
